<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Command;

use App\Application\Billing\ReportService;
use App\Application\Parse\JsonInput;
use App\Exception\BillingException;
use DateTimeImmutable;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Attribute\AsCommand;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Command\Command;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Input\InputInterface;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Input\InputOption;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Output\OutputInterface;

#[AsCommand(
    name: 'app:billing:report',
    description: 'CSV report per (user, model) for a time range; printed to stdout.',
)]
final class ReportCommand extends Command
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly ReportService $reports,
    ) {
        parent::__construct();
    }

    protected function configure(): void
    {
        $this
            ->addOption('from', null, InputOption::VALUE_REQUIRED, 'Range start, inclusive, ISO-8601 UTC (Z), compared with event ts')
            ->addOption('to', null, InputOption::VALUE_REQUIRED, 'Range end, exclusive, ISO-8601 UTC (Z), compared with event ts')
            ->setHelp(
                'Aggregates rated events (unrated are never included) by (user, model) and prints '
                .'the CSV per TASK.md section 7 to stdout: one row per pair '
                .'(totals of token counters and cost_usd, 6 decimal places) plus a TOTAL row. '
                .'`--from` is inclusive, `--to` exclusive; when both are given, from <= to. '
                .'Exit code: 0 on success, 1 on invalid options or errors.'
            );
    }

    protected function execute(InputInterface $input, OutputInterface $output): int
    {
        $from = $this->parseRangeOption((string) $input->getOption('from'), '--from', $output);
        if ($from === false) {
            return Command::FAILURE;
        }
        $to = $this->parseRangeOption((string) $input->getOption('to'), '--to', $output);
        if ($to === false) {
            return Command::FAILURE;
        }

        if ($from !== null && $to !== null && $from > $to) {
            $output->writeln('<error>--from must be <= --to</error>');

            return Command::FAILURE;
        }

        try {
            $csv = $this->reports->buildCsv($from, $to);
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            $output->writeln(sprintf('<error>report failed: %s</error>', $e->getMessage()));

            return Command::FAILURE;
        }

        $output->write($csv);

        return Command::SUCCESS;
    }

    private function parseRangeOption(
        string $value,
        string $option,
        OutputInterface $output,
    ): DateTimeImmutable|false {
        if ($value === '') {
            return null;
        }

        try {
            return JsonInput::isoUtcDateTime(['value' => $value], 'value', sprintf('%s', $option), BillingException::class);
        } catch (BillingException $e) {
            $output->writeln(sprintf('<error>%s: %s</error>', $option, $e->getMessage()));

            return false;
        }
    }
}

#[AsCommand(

    description: 'Retroactively apply a price correction and recompute already-rated events.',
)]
final class RepreiceCommand extends Command
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly PriceFileParser $parser,
        private readonly RepriceService $reprice,
    ) {
        parent::__construct();
    }

    protected function configure(): void
    {
        $this
            ->addArgument('file', InputArgument::REQUIRED, 'Path to the price-correction JSON file (same format as the price history)')
            ->setHelp(
                'Upserts provider/model/price rows from the file (providers by code, price rows by '
                .'(provider, model, valid_from); every referenced model and provider must already exist '
                .'in the loaded reference data). Then every already-rated event that was charged with a '
                .'touched price row is recomputed with the new rates (and the current off-peak policy); '
                .'each recomputation is audited in the price_corrections journal (old and new cost). '
                .'Unrated events are left pending for the next app:billing:rate. '
                .'Exit code: 0 on success, 1 on invalid file or unknown provider/model.'
            );
    }

    protected function execute(InputInterface $input, OutputInterface $output): int
    {
        $path = (string) $input->getArgument('file');

        if (!is_file($path)) {
            $output->writeln(sprintf('<error>file not found: %s</error>', $path));

            return Command::FAILURE;
        }

        $json = @file_get_contents($path);
        if ($json === false) {
            $output->writeln(sprintf('<error>cannot read file: %s</error>', $path));

            return Command::FAILURE;
        }

        try {
            $spec = $this->parser->parse($json);
        } catch (InvalidPricesFileException $e) {
            $output->writeln(sprintf('<error>invalid price-correction file: %s</error>', $e->getMessage()));

            return Command::FAILURE;
        }

        try {
            $result = $this->reprice->reprice($spec);
        } catch (InvalidRepriceFileException $e) {
            $output->writeln(sprintf('<error>reprice failed: %s</error>', $e->getMessage()));

            return Command::FAILURE;
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            $output->writeln(sprintf('<error>reprice failed: %s</error>', $e->getMessage()));

            return Command::FAILURE;
        }

        $output->writeln(sprintf('recomputed events: %d', $result['events']));
        $output->writeln(sprintf('cost delta (new - old): %s', $result['delta_usd']));

        return Command::SUCCESS;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Command;

use App\Application\Billing\RatingService;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Attribute\AsCommand;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Command\Command;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Input\InputInterface;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Output\OutputInterface;

#[AsCommand(
    name: 'app:billing:rate',
    description: 'Rate pending usage events (idempotent; every run retries unrated events).',
)]
final class RateCommand extends Command
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly RatingService $rater,
    ) {
        parent::__construct();
    }

    protected function configure(): void
    {
        $this->setHelp(
            'For every pending event, picks the price row of the event model with the greatest '
            .'`valid_from <= event ts` (no row yet => event stays unrated). '
            .'Cost is computed with exact decimal math, rounded exactly once (HALF_UP, 6 places). '
            .'Each (provider, request) is charged at most once (dedup is done at import). '
            .'Every run retries all still-unrated events, so a late price import unblocks them. '
            .'Exit code: 0 (even when some events stay unrated — they are reported), 1 on error.'
        );
    }

    protected function execute(InputInterface $input, OutputInterface $output): int
    {
        try {
            $result = $this->rater->rateAll();
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            $output->writeln(sprintf('<error>rating failed: %s</error>', $e->getMessage()));

            return Command::FAILURE;
        }

        $output->writeln(sprintf('rated: %d', $result->ratedCount));
        $output->writeln(sprintf('unrated: %d', count($result->unrated)));

        foreach ($result->unrated as $event) {
            $output->writeln(sprintf(
                '  %s / %s ts=%s',
                $event->provider,
                $event->providerRequestId,
                $event->ts->format('Y-m-d\TH:i:s\Z'),
            ));
        }

        return Command::SUCCESS;
    }
}

Fix: make the closure `static function () use ($em, $spec)` and drop the parameter. Let me rewrite these closures.

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Domain\Usage;

use App\Domain\Billing\TokenCounts;
use App\Domain\Pricing\Model;
use App\Domain\Pricing\Provider;
use App\Domain\Pricing\PriceRow;
use DateTimeImmutable;
use Doctrine\ORM\Mapping as ORM;

/**
 * Событие использования LLM, поставленное провайдером.
 *
 * Естественный ключ — (provider, provider_request_id); повторная доставка
 * уже известной пары целиком игнорируется (п. 5 задания).
 *
 * До расчёта — статус pending, cost null; после `app:billing:rate` —
 * rated с зафиксированной строкой цен и стоимостью (уже округлённой до 6).
 */
#[ORM\Entity]
#[ORM\Table(name: 'usage_events')]
#[ORM\UniqueConstraint(name: 'uniq_usage_events_provider_request', columns: ['provider', 'provider_request_id'])]
final class UsageEvent
{
    #[ORM\Id]
    #[ORM\GeneratedValue]
    #[ORM\TypedIdentifier]
    #[ORM\Column(type: 'bigint')]
    private null|int $id = null;

    #[ORM\Column(name: 'provider_request_id', type: 'string', length: 255)]
    private string $providerRequestId;

    #[ORM\Column(type: 'string', length: 255)]
    private string $user;

    #[ORM\Column(name: 'ts', type: 'datetime_immutable')]
    private DateTimeImmutable $ts;

    #[ORM\Column(name: 'tokens_input', type: 'bigint')]
    private int $tokensInput;

    #[ORM\Column(name: 'tokens_output', type: 'bigint')]
    private int $tokensOutput;

    #[ORM\Column(name: 'tokens_cache_read', type: 'bigint')]
    private int $tokensCacheRead;

    #[ORM\Column(name: 'tokens_cache_write', type: 'bigint')]
    private int $tokensCacheWrite;

    #[ORM\Column(type: 'string', length: 16, options: ['default' => 'pending'])]
    private UsageStatus $status = UsageStatus::Pending;

    /** Стоимость события в USD, округлённая до 6 знаков (п. 4 задания). */
    #[ORM\Column(type: 'decimal', precision: 20, scale: 6, options: ['default' => null])]
    private null|string $cost = null;

    #[ORM\Column(name: 'rated_at', type: 'datetime_immutable', options: ['default' => null])]
    private null|DateTimeImmutable $ratedAt = null;

    #[ORM\Column(name: 'created_at', type: 'datetime_immutable')]
    private DateTimeImmutable $createdAt;

    #[ORM\ManyToOne(targetEntity: Provider::class)]
    private Provider $provider;

    #[ORM\ManyToOne(targetEntity: Model::class)]
    private Model $model;

    /** Строка цен, по которой событие тарифицировано (null, пока unrated). */
    #[ORM\ManyToOne(targetEntity: PriceRow::class)]
    private null|PriceRow $priceRow = null;

    public function __construct(
        Provider $provider,
        Model $model,
        string $providerRequestId,
        string $user,
        DateTimeImmutable $ts,
        TokenCounts $tokens,
    ) {
        $this->provider = $provider;
        $this->model = $model;
        $this->providerRequestId = $providerRequestId;
        $this->user = $user;
        $this->ts = $ts;
        $this->tokensInput = $tokens->input;
        $this->tokensOutput = $tokens->output;
        $this->tokensCacheRead = $tokens->cacheRead;
        $this->tokensCacheWrite = $tokens->cacheWrite;
        $this->status = UsageStatus::Pending;
        $this->createdAt = new DateTimeImmutable();
    }

    /**
     * Фиксация результата расчёта («одно событие — одна стоимость»).
     */
    public function markRated(string $cost, PriceRow $priceRow, DateTimeImmutable $ratedAt): void
    {
        $this->status = UsageStatus::Rated;
        $this->cost = $cost;
        $this->priceRow = $priceRow;
        $this->ratedAt = $ratedAt;
    }

    /**
     * Обновление стоимости после ретро-коррекции цены (статус rated сохраняется).
     */
    public function changeRatedCost(string $cost): void
    {
        $this->cost = $cost;
    }

    public function getId(): null|int
    {
        return $this->id;
    }

    public function getProviderRequestId(): string
    {
        return $this->providerRequestId;
    }

    public function getUser(): string
    {
        return $this->user;
    }

    public function getTs(): DateTimeImmutable
    {
        return $this->ts;
    }

    public function getTokensInput(): int
    {
        return $this->tokensInput;
    }

    public function getTokensOutput(): int
    {
        return $this->tokensOutput;
    }

    public function getTokensCacheRead(): int
    {
        return $this->tokensCacheRead;
    }

    public function getTokensCacheWrite(): int
    {
        return $this->tokensCacheWrite;
    }

    public function getTokenCounts(): TokenCounts
    {
        return new TokenCounts(
            $this->tokensInput,
            $this->tokensOutput,
            $this->tokensCacheRead,
            $this->tokensCacheWrite,
        );
    }

    public function getStatus(): UsageStatus
    {
        return $this->status;
    }

    public function getCost(): null|string
    {
        return $this->cost;
    }

    public function getRatedAt(): null|DateTimeImmutable
    {
        return $this->ratedAt;
    }

    public function getCreatedAt(): DateTimeImmutable
    {
        return $this->createdAt;
    }

    public function getProvider(): Provider
    {
        return $this->provider;
    }

    public function getModel(): Model
    {
        return $this->model;
    }

    public function getPriceRow(): null|PriceRow
    {
        return $this->priceRow;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Doctrine\ORM\Mapping;

use Doctrine\DBAL\Platforms\AbstractPlatform;
use Doctrine\ORM\Internal\SQLResultCasing;

use function array_map;
use function array_merge;
use function assert;
use function explode;
use function implode;
use function is_numeric;
use function preg_replace;
use function sprintf;
use function substr;

/**
 * A set of rules for determining the physical column, alias and table quotes
 */
class DefaultQuoteStrategy implements QuoteStrategy
{
    use SQLResultCasing;

    public function getColumnName(string $fieldName, ClassMetadata $class, AbstractPlatform $platform): string
    {
        return isset($class->fieldMappings[$fieldName]->quoted)
            ? $platform->quoteSingleIdentifier($class->fieldMappings[$fieldName]->columnName)
            : $class->fieldMappings[$fieldName]->columnName;
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritDoc}
     *
     * @todo Table names should be computed in DBAL depending on the platform
     */
    public function getTableName(ClassMetadata $class, AbstractPlatform $platform): string
    {
        $tableName = $class->table['name'];

        if (! empty($class->table['schema'])) {
            return isset($class->table['quoted'])
                ? sprintf(
                    '%s.%s',
                    $platform->quoteSingleIdentifier($class->table['schema']),
                    $platform->quoteSingleIdentifier($tableName),
                )
                : $class->table['schema'] . '.' . $class->table['name'];
        }

        return isset($class->table['quoted'])
            ? $platform->quoteSingleIdentifier($tableName)
            : $tableName;
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritDoc}
     */
    public function getSequenceName(array $definition, ClassMetadata $class, AbstractPlatform $platform): string
    {
        return isset($definition['quoted'])
            ? implode('.', array_map(
                static fn (string $part) => $platform->quoteSingleIdentifier($part),
                explode('.', $definition['sequenceName']),
            ))
            : $definition['sequenceName'];
    }

    public function getJoinColumnName(JoinColumnMapping $joinColumn, ClassMetadata $class, AbstractPlatform $platform): string
    {
        return isset($joinColumn->quoted)
            ? $platform->quoteSingleIdentifier($joinColumn->name)
            : $joinColumn->name;
    }

    public function getReferencedJoinColumnName(
        JoinColumnMapping $joinColumn,
        ClassMetadata $class,
        AbstractPlatform $platform,
    ): string {
        return isset($joinColumn->quoted)
            ? $platform->quoteSingleIdentifier($joinColumn->referencedColumnName)
            : $joinColumn->referencedColumnName;
    }

    public function getJoinTableName(
        ManyToManyOwningSideMapping $association,
        ClassMetadata $class,
        AbstractPlatform $platform,
    ): string {
        $schema = '';

        if (isset($association->joinTable->schema)) {
            $schema = $association->joinTable->schema . '.';
        }

        $tableName = $association->joinTable->name;

        if (isset($association->joinTable->quoted)) {
            $tableName = $platform->quoteSingleIdentifier($tableName);
        }

        return $schema . $tableName;
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritDoc}
     */
    public function getIdentifierColumnNames(ClassMetadata $class, AbstractPlatform $platform): array
    {
        $quotedColumnNames = [];

        foreach ($class->identifier as $fieldName) {
            if (isset($class->fieldMappings[$fieldName])) {
                $quotedColumnNames[] = $this->getColumnName($fieldName, $class, $platform);

                continue;
            }

            // Association defined as Id field
            $assoc = $class->associationMappings[$fieldName];
            assert($assoc->isToOneOwningSide());
            $joinColumns            = $assoc->joinColumns;
            $assocQuotedColumnNames = array_map(
                static fn (JoinColumnMapping $joinColumn) => isset($joinColumn->quoted)
                    ? $platform->quoteSingleIdentifier($joinColumn->name)
                    : $joinColumn->name,
                $joinColumns,
            );

            $quotedColumnNames = array_merge($quotedColumnNames, $assocQuotedColumnNames);
        }

        return $quotedColumnNames;
    }

    public function getColumnAlias(
        string $columnName,
        int $counter,
        AbstractPlatform $platform,
        ClassMetadata|null $class = null,
    ): string {
        // 1 ) Concatenate column name and counter
        // 2 ) Trim the column alias to the maximum identifier length of the platform.
        //     If the alias is to long, characters are cut off from the beginning.
        // 3 ) Strip non alphanumeric characters
        // 4 ) Prefix with "_" if the result its numeric
        $columnName .= '_' . $counter;
        $columnName  = substr($columnName, -$platform->getMaxIdentifierLength());
        $columnName  = preg_replace('/[^A-Za-z0-9_]/', '', $columnName);
        $columnName  = is_numeric($columnName) ? '_' . $columnName : $columnName;

        return $this->getSQLResultCasing($platform, $columnName);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Doctrine;

use Doctrine\DBAL\Platforms\AbstractPlatform;
use Doctrine\ORM\Mapping\ClassMetadata;
use Doctrine\ORM\Mapping\DefaultQuoteStrategy;

/**
 * Цитирует столбцы, которые являются служебными в PostgreSQL
 * (`user` — col_name_keyword: в списках колок CREATE/INSERT/UPDATE без
 * кавычек разбор падает). Остальные идентификаторы — как в дефолтной
 * стратегии.
 */
final class UserQuotedQuoteStrategy extends DefaultQuoteStrategy
{
    private const RESERVED_COLUMN_NAMES = ['user'];

    public function getColumnName(string $fieldName, ClassMetadata $class, AbstractPlatform $platform): string
    {
        $mapping = $class->fieldMappings[$fieldName];
        if (in_array($mapping->columnName, self::RESERVED_COLUMN_NAMES, true)) {
            return $platform->quoteSingleIdentifier($mapping->columnName);
        }

        return $mapping->columnName;
    }
}

Read `TASK.md` in `/tmp/billing-pi-zdkmfh18/repo` and complete the PHP backend assignment: build an LLM token expense accounting service that imports provider/model/price-history JSON, imports usage-event JSONL, rates pending usage events, produces a CSV report per user/model for a time range, supports duplicate delivery, exact decimal money math, off-peak discounts, and bonus retroactive price correction.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Repository path: `/tmp/billing-pi-zdkmfh18/repo`.
- PHP `8.5.11` with `bcmath`, PDO, and JSON support.
- Installed stack includes Symfony Console `8.1.9`, Doctrine ORM `3.7.5`, DBAL `4.5.0`, DoctrineBundle `3.3.2`, Doctrine Migrations `3.9.8`.
- PostgreSQL 17 is running at `127.0.0.1:5544`, database `app`, user `app`.

  - Duplicate usage events by `(provider, provider_request_id)` must be ignored.
  - Unknown provider/model must fail import with exit code 1.
  - Money calculation must use exact decimal arithmetic, not floats.

  - `--from` is inclusive, `--to` is exclusive.

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Doctrine\ORM\Mapping;

use Doctrine\DBAL\Platforms\AbstractPlatform;
use Doctrine\ORM\Internal\SQLResultCasing;

use function array_map;
use function array_merge;
use function assert;
use function explode;
use function implode;
use function is_numeric;
use function preg_replace;
use function sprintf;
use function substr;

/**
 * A set of rules for determining the physical column, alias and table quotes
 */
class DefaultQuoteStrategy implements QuoteStrategy
{
    use SQLResultCasing;

    public function getColumnName(string $fieldName, ClassMetadata $class, AbstractPlatform $platform): string
    {
        return isset($class->fieldMappings[$fieldName]->quoted)
            ? $platform->quoteSingleIdentifier($class->fieldMappings[$fieldName]->columnName)
            : $class->fieldMappings[$fieldName]->columnName;
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritDoc}
     *
     * @todo Table names should be computed in DBAL depending on the platform
     */
    public function getTableName(ClassMetadata $class, AbstractPlatform $platform): string
    {
        $tableName = $class->table['name'];

        if (! empty($class->table['schema'])) {
            return isset($class->table['quoted'])
                ? sprintf(
                    '%s.%s',
                    $platform->quoteSingleIdentifier($class->table['schema']),
                    $platform->quoteSingleIdentifier($tableName),
                )
                : $class->table['schema'] . '.' . $class->table['name'];
        }

        return isset($class->table['quoted'])
            ? $platform->quoteSingleIdentifier($tableName)
            : $tableName;
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritDoc}
     */
    public function getSequenceName(array $definition, ClassMetadata $class, AbstractPlatform $platform): string
    {
        return isset($definition['quoted'])
            ? implode('.', array_map(
                static fn (string $part) => $platform->quoteSingleIdentifier($part),
                explode('.', $definition['sequenceName']),
            ))
            : $definition['sequenceName'];
    }

    public function getJoinColumnName(JoinColumnMapping $joinColumn, ClassMetadata $class, AbstractPlatform $platform): string
    {
        return isset($joinColumn->quoted)
            ? $platform->quoteSingleIdentifier($joinColumn->name)
            : $joinColumn->name;
    }

    public function getReferencedJoinColumnName(
        JoinColumnMapping $joinColumn,
        ClassMetadata $class,
        AbstractPlatform $platform,
    ): string {
        return isset($joinColumn->quoted)
            ? $platform->quoteSingleIdentifier($joinColumn->referencedColumnName)
            : $joinColumn->referencedColumnName;
    }

    public function getJoinTableName(
        ManyToManyOwningSideMapping $association,
        ClassMetadata $class,
        AbstractPlatform $platform,
    ): string {
        $schema = '';

        if (isset($association->joinTable->schema)) {
            $schema = $association->joinTable->schema . '.';
        }

        $tableName = $association->joinTable->name;

        if (isset($association->joinTable->quoted)) {
            $tableName = $platform->quoteSingleIdentifier($tableName);
        }

        return $schema . $tableName;
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritDoc}
     */
    public function getIdentifierColumnNames(ClassMetadata $class, AbstractPlatform $platform): array
    {
        $quotedColumnNames = [];

        foreach ($class->identifier as $fieldName) {
            if (isset($class->fieldMappings[$fieldName])) {
                $quotedColumnNames[] = $this->getColumnName($fieldName, $class, $platform);

                continue;
            }

            // Association defined as Id field
            $assoc = $class->associationMappings[$fieldName];
            assert($assoc->isToOneOwningSide());
            $joinColumns            = $assoc->joinColumns;
            $assocQuotedColumnNames = array_map(
                static fn (JoinColumnMapping $joinColumn) => isset($joinColumn->quoted)
                    ? $platform->quoteSingleIdentifier($joinColumn->name)
                    : $joinColumn->name,
                $joinColumns,
            );

            $quotedColumnNames = array_merge($quotedColumnNames, $assocQuotedColumnNames);
        }

        return $quotedColumnNames;
    }

    public function getColumnAlias(
        string $columnName,
        int $counter,
        AbstractPlatform $platform,
        ClassMetadata|null $class = null,
    ): string {
        // 1 ) Concatenate column name and counter
        // 2 ) Trim the column alias to the maximum identifier length of the platform.
        //     If the alias is to long, characters are cut off from the beginning.
        // 3 ) Strip non alphanumeric characters
        // 4 ) Prefix with "_" if the result its numeric
        $columnName .= '_' . $counter;
        $columnName  = substr($columnName, -$platform->getMaxIdentifierLength());
        $columnName  = preg_replace('/[^A-Za-z0-9_]/', '', $columnName);
        $columnName  = is_numeric($columnName) ? '_' . $columnName : $columnName;

        return $this->getSQLResultCasing($platform, $columnName);
    }
}

namespace Symfony\Component\DependencyInjection\Compiler;

use Symfony\Component\DependencyInjection\ContainerBuilder;
use Symfony\Component\DependencyInjection\Reference;

/**
 * Removes unused service definitions from the container.
 *
 * @author Johannes M. Schmitt <schmittjoh@gmail.com>
 * @author Nicolas Grekas <p@tchwork.com>
 */
class RemoveUnusedDefinitionsPass extends AbstractRecursivePass
{
    protected bool $skipScalars = true;

    private array $connectedIds = [];

    /**
     * Processes the ContainerBuilder to remove unused definitions.
     */
    public function process(ContainerBuilder $container): void
    {
        try {
            $this->enableExpressionProcessing();
            $this->container = $container;
            $connectedIds = [];
            $aliases = $container->getAliases();

            foreach ($aliases as $id => $alias) {
                if ($alias->isPublic()) {
                    $this->connectedIds[] = (string) $aliases[$id];
                }
            }

            foreach ($container->getDefinitions() as $id => $definition) {
                if ($definition->isPublic()) {
                    $connectedIds[$id] = true;
                    $this->processValue($definition);
                }
            }

            while ($this->connectedIds) {
                $ids = $this->connectedIds;
                $this->connectedIds = [];
                foreach ($ids as $id) {
                    if (!isset($connectedIds[$id]) && $container->hasDefinition($id)) {
                        $connectedIds[$id] = true;
                        $this->processValue($container->getDefinition($id));
                    }
                }
            }

            foreach ($container->getDefinitions() as $id => $definition) {
                if (!isset($connectedIds[$id])) {
                    $container->removeDefinition($id);
                    $container->resolveEnvPlaceholders(!$definition->hasErrors() ? serialize($definition) : $definition);
                    $container->log($this, \sprintf('Removed service "%s"; reason: unused.', $id));
                }
            }
        } finally {
            $this->container = null;
            $this->connectedIds = [];
        }
    }

    protected function processValue(mixed $value, bool $isRoot = false): mixed
    {
        if (!$value instanceof Reference) {
            return parent::processValue($value, $isRoot);
        }

        if (ContainerBuilder::IGNORE_ON_UNINITIALIZED_REFERENCE !== $value->getInvalidBehavior()) {
            $this->connectedIds[] = (string) $value;
        }

        return $value;
    }
}

use Symfony\Component\DependencyInjection\ContainerBuilder;
use Symfony\Component\DependencyInjection\ContainerInterface;
use Symfony\Component\DependencyInjection\Exception\ServiceNotFoundException;
use Symfony\Component\DependencyInjection\Reference;

/**
 * Checks that all references are pointing to a valid service.
 *
 * @author Johannes M. Schmitt <schmittjoh@gmail.com>
 */
class CheckExceptionOnInvalidReferenceBehaviorPass extends AbstractRecursivePass
{
    protected bool $skipScalars = true;

    private array $serviceLocatorContextIds = [];

    public function process(ContainerBuilder $container): void
    {
        $this->serviceLocatorContextIds = [];
        foreach ($container->findTaggedServiceIds('container.service_locator_context') as $id => $tags) {
            $this->serviceLocatorContextIds[$id] = $tags[0]['id'];
            $container->getDefinition($id)->clearTag('container.service_locator_context');
        }

        try {
            parent::process($container);
        } finally {
            $this->serviceLocatorContextIds = [];
        }
    }

    protected function processValue(mixed $value, bool $isRoot = false): mixed
    {
        if (!$value instanceof Reference) {
            return parent::processValue($value, $isRoot);
        }
        if (ContainerInterface::EXCEPTION_ON_INVALID_REFERENCE < $value->getInvalidBehavior() || $this->container->has((string) $value)) {
            return $value;
        }

        $currentId = $this->currentId;
        $graph = $this->container->getCompiler()->getServiceReferenceGraph();

        if (isset($this->serviceLocatorContextIds[$currentId])) {
            $currentId = $this->serviceLocatorContextIds[$currentId];
            $locator = $this->container->getDefinition($this->currentId)->getFactory()[0];
            $this->throwServiceNotFoundException($value, $currentId, $locator->getArgument(0));
        }

        if ('.' === $currentId[0] && $graph->hasNode($currentId)) {
            foreach ($graph->getNode($currentId)->getInEdges() as $edge) {
                if (!$edge->getValue() instanceof Reference || ContainerInterface::EXCEPTION_ON_INVALID_REFERENCE < $edge->getValue()->getInvalidBehavior()) {
                    continue;
                }
                $sourceId = $edge->getSourceNode()->getId();

                if ('.' !== $sourceId[0]) {
                    $currentId = $sourceId;
                    break;
                }

                if (isset($this->serviceLocatorContextIds[$sourceId])) {
                    $currentId = $this->serviceLocatorContextIds[$sourceId];
                    $locator = $this->container->getDefinition($this->currentId);
                    $this->throwServiceNotFoundException($value, $currentId, $locator->getArgument(0));
                }
            }
        }

        $this->throwServiceNotFoundException($value, $currentId, $value);
    }

    private function throwServiceNotFoundException(Reference $ref, string $sourceId, mixed $value): void
    {
        $id = (string) $ref;
        $alternatives = [];
        foreach ($this->container->getServiceIds() as $knownId) {
            if ('' === $knownId || '.' === $knownId[0] || $knownId === $this->currentId) {
                continue;
            }

            $lev = levenshtein($id, $knownId);
            if ($lev <= \strlen($id) / 3 || str_contains($knownId, $id)) {
                $alternatives[] = $knownId;
            }
        }

        $pass = new class extends AbstractRecursivePass {
            public Reference $ref;
            public string $sourceId;
            public array $alternatives;

            public function processValue(mixed $value, bool $isRoot = false): mixed
            {
                if ($this->ref !== $value) {
                    return parent::processValue($value, $isRoot);
                }
                $sourceId = $this->sourceId;
                if (null !== $this->currentId && $this->currentId !== (string) $value) {
                    $sourceId = $this->currentId.'" in the container provided to "'.$sourceId;
                }

                throw new ServiceNotFoundException((string) $value, $sourceId, null, $this->alternatives);
            }
        };
        $pass->ref = $ref;
        $pass->sourceId = $sourceId;
        $pass->alternatives = $alternatives;

        $pass->processValue($value, true);
    }
}

    public function build(ContainerBuilder $container): void
    {
        if (!str_contains((string)getenv('APP_DEBUG_DUMP'), '1')) {

The report says u-alice,prism/lumen-8 = 14262499.000000 = 14.262499 × 1e6. The token count matches (report total input 1200000). So in the cost calculation, `tokens × rate / 1e6` was done, but then... the total was 14262499 — exactly base×1e6? 14.26249875 × 1e6 = 14262498.75. Hmm, the report says 14262499.000000. So the reported cost is the "sum(tokens × rate)" itself, with /1e6 not applied (and then rounded). In other words, `perMillion` isn't dividing — does `Decimal::div` return the product?? Or `RoundHalfUp`... let me check Decimal.

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Domain\Shared;

use RuntimeException;

/**
 * Утилиты точной десятичной арифметики на bcmath (float для денег запрещён).
 *
 * Все строки — канонические десятичные числа: опциональный «-», целая часть
 * (без ведущих нулей), опциональная дробная часть.
 */
final class Decimal
{
    /** Запас точности для промежуточных операций (ставка до 10 знаков + множители). */
    public const SCALE = 32;

    private function __construct()
    {
    }

    public static function mul(string $a, string $b): string
    {
        return bcmul($a, $b, self::SCALE);
    }

    public static function div(string $a, string $b): string
    {
        if (bccomp($b, '0', 0) === 0) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Decimal division by zero');
        }

        return bcdiv($a, $b, self::SCALE);
    }

    public static function add(string $a, string $b): string
    {
        return self::normalize(bcadd($a, $b, self::SCALE));
    }

    public static function sub(string $a, string $b): string
    {
        return self::normalize(bcsub($a, $b, self::SCALE));
    }

    /**
     * @param iterable<string> $values
     */
    public static function sum(iterable $values): string
    {
        $total = '0';
        foreach ($values as $value) {
            $total = self::add($total, $value);
        }

        return $total;
    }

    /**
     * Округление до $digits знаков после точки, HALF_UP (0.5 всегда «вверх по абсолюту»,
     * т.е. 2.5 → 3, -2.5 → -3).
     */
    public static function roundHalfUp(string $value, int $digits = 6): string
    {
        if ($digits < 0) {
            throw new RuntimeException('digits must be >= 0');
        }

        $negative = str_starts_with($value, '-');
        $abs = $negative ? substr($value, 1) : self::stripPlus($value);

        $rounded = bcadd(bcmul($abs, self::power10($digits), self::SCALE), '0.5', 0);

        return self::normalize($negative ? '-'.$rounded : $rounded);
    }

    /**
     * Приведение к канонической десятичной строке (убирает ведущие/хвостовые нули).
     */
    public static function normalize(string $value): string
    {
        return self::normalizeInternal($value);
    }

    /**
     * Форматирование ровно до 6 знаков после точки (значение должно быть
     * не длиннее 6 знаков; лишние знаки отсекаются, ведущие/хвостовые нули — нормализованы).
     */
    public static function format6(string $value): string
    {
        $value = self::normalizeInternal($value);
        $negative = str_starts_with($value, '-');
        $abs = $negative ? substr($value, 1) : self::stripPlus($value);

        if (!preg_match('/^\d+(\.\d+)?$/', $abs)) {
            throw new RuntimeException(sprintf('Cannot format decimal value "%s"', $value));
        }

        if (str_contains($abs, '.')) {
            [$int, $frac] = explode('.', $abs, 2);
            $frac = str_pad(substr($frac, 0, 6), 6, '0');
        } else {
            $int = $abs;
            $frac = '000000';
        }

        $int = ltrim($int, '0');
        if ($int === '') {
            $int = '0';
        }

        return ($negative && $int !== '0' ? '-' : '').$int.'.'.$frac;
    }

    private static function power10(int $n): string
    {
        $result = '1';
        for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
            $result .= '0';
        }

        return $result;
    }

    private static function normalizeInternal(string $value): string
    {
        $value = self::stripPlus($value);
        $negative = str_starts_with($value, '-');
        $abs = $negative ? substr($value, 1) : $value;

        if (str_contains($abs, '.')) {
            [$int, $frac] = explode('.', $abs, 2);
            $frac = rtrim($frac, '0');
            $abs = $frac === '' ? $int : $int.'.'.$frac;
        }

        $int = ltrim($abs, '0');
        if ($int === '') {
            $int = '0';
        }

        return ($negative && $int !== '0' ? '-' : '').$int;
    }

    private static function stripPlus(string $value): string
    {
        return ltrim($value, '+');
    }
}

## Goal
Read `TASK.md` in `/tmp/billing-pi-zdkmfh18/repo` and complete the PHP backend assignment: build an LLM token expense accounting service that imports provider/model/price-history JSON, imports usage-event JSONL, rates pending usage events, produces a CSV report per user/model for a time range, supports duplicate delivery, exact decimal money math, off-peak discounts, and bonus retroactive price correction.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Repository path: `/tmp/billing-pi-zdkmfh18/repo`.
- PHP `8.5.11` with `bcmath`, PDO, and JSON support.
- Installed stack includes Symfony Console `8.1.9`, Doctrine ORM `3.7.5`, DBAL `4.5.0`, DoctrineBundle `3.3.2`, Doctrine Migrations `3.9.8`.
- PostgreSQL 17 is running at `127.0.0.1:5544`, database `app`, user `app`.
- `DATABASE_URL` is configured as `postgresql://app:app@127.0.0.1:5544/app?serverVersion=17&charset=utf8`.
- Doctrine mapping is attribute-based under `src/` with alias `App`.
- Existing live database schema must be preserved/recreated by a migration.
- Fixtures to validate against: `fixtures/prices.json`, `fixtures/usage.jsonl`.
- `instanceof \\Some\Class` (double backslash) is **invalid PHP syntax**; must use `instanceof \Some\Class` (single leading backslash).
- `CompilerPass` class does NOT exist in this Symfony version; use `CompilerPassInterface` instead.
- Symfony bundle YAML config: `controller_resolver` belongs under `doctrine.orm`, NOT under `doctrine.orm.entity_managers.default`.
- `entity_managers.default` accepted keys include: `auto_mapping`, `naming_strategy`, `quote_strategy`, `mappings`, `dql`, etc.

## Progress
### Done
- [x] Inspected repository, `TASK.md`, `README.md`, `composer.json`, `Makefile`, `.env`, `docker-compose.yml`, and fixtures.
- [x] Verified runtime, vendor packages, PostgreSQL availability, and `bin/console` boot.
- [x] Confirmed live database already contains required tables and fixture-aligned reference data.
- [x] Built complete domain layer (Decimal, TimeOfDay, PriceUnit, Provider, Model, PriceRow, TokenCounts, OffPeakPolicy, RateCalculator, UsageStatus, UsageEvent, PriceCorrection).
- [x] Created exceptions and shared JSON input validation.
- [x] Created price-file parsing, usage-event parsing, application services (PricesImport, UsageImport, Rating, Report, Reprice).
- [x] Created all 5 console commands.
- [x] Generated and tested migration (`Version20261017082358.php`).
- [x] Fixed multiple Doctrine/runtime issues (optional: argument, transactional, GeneratedValue, enum mappings, DQL aliases, nullable WHERE binding).
- [x] First successful `app:billing:import-prices` run.
- [x] Calculated expected fixture results: e1=`14.262499`, e2=`11.000000`, e3=`8.400000`.
- [x] **Fixed `RepreiceCommand` class-name typo** (extra 'e') in `/tmp/billing-pi-zdkmfh18/repo/src/Command/RepriceCommand.php` — this was cascading into "non-existent service" DI errors.
- [x] **Created custom `UserQuotedQuoteStrategy`** at `/tmp/billing-pi-zdkmfh18/repo/src/Doctrine/UserQuotedQuoteStrategy.php`:
  - Extends `DefaultQuoteStrategy`.
  - Overrides `getColumnName()` to quote `'user'` via `$platform->quoteSingleIdentifier()`.
  - Registered in `config/packages/doctrine.yaml` under `entity_managers.default.quote_strategy`.
- [x] **Verified QuoteStrategy is properly wired**: diagnostic compiler pass confirmed `hasDef=true`, `quoteRefs=[App\Doctrine\UserQuotedQuoteStrategy]` after both optimization and removal passes.
- [x] Restructured `config/packages/doctrine.yaml` to correct YAML hierarchy (controller_resolver at orm level, mappings under entity_managers.default).
- [x] Confirmed `usage_events.user` column now quoted in INSERT (roundtrip test passed).

### In Progress
- [ ] Re-run full acceptance pipeline end-to-end and verify output matches expected costs.
- [ ] Validate duplicate handling, unrated retry behavior, report totals, retroactive recompute, and price-correction audit.
- [ ] Clean up temporary debug compiler pass code from `/tmp/billing-pi-zdkmfh18/repo/src/Kernel.php`.

### Blocked
- [None currently]

## Key Decisions
- **Implement against the existing live DDL**: application code matches the existing schema; migration recreated for clean databases.
- **Use exact bcmath decimal math**: intermediate scale `32`, final one-time `HALF_UP` rounding to 6 decimals.
- **Select price row by greatest `valid_from <= event.ts`**: boundary is inclusive.
- **Apply off-peak by event UTC local minute**: provider policy can have windows crossing midnight.
- **Deduplicate usage events by `(provider, provider_request_id)`**: duplicates counted but not recharged.
- **Fail the whole usage file on any malformed line**: matches import error requirement.
- **Use `Connection::transactional`**: ORM `EntityManager::transactional` unavailable; DBAL version is.
- **Capture `$em` in transaction closures**: DBAL invokes closure without arguments.
- **Use fully qualified DQL entity names**: avoids unresolved alias errors.
- **Use dynamic WHERE in report**: avoids `SQLSTATE[42P18]` from nullable parameters.
- **Strict price-file schema**: `prices` required; `providers`/`models` optional.
- **Retroactive correction only touches already-rated events**: pending events remain pending.
- **Audit retroactive corrections**: `price_corrections` stores old/new cost per event.
- **Migration must create tables in dependency order**.
- **Custom `QuoteStrategy` for reserved `user` column**: rather than per-column `options: ['quoted' => true]`, a strategy-level fix covers all SQL generation paths (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, JOIN) uniformly.
- **Register QuoteStrategy via `entity_managers.default.quote_strategy`**: the doctrine-bundle Configuration node (`Configuration.php:577`) accepts it as a scalar service ID per entity manager.

1. Remove temporary debug compiler pass from `/tmp/billing-pi-zdkmfh18/repo/src/Kernel.php` (restore original `build()` method or remove it).
2. Run full acceptance pipeline:

   - `php bin/console app:billing:rate`

   - `php bin/console app:billing:reprice` (with appropriate fixture)
3. Validate report output matches expected: e1=`14.262499`, e2=`11.000000`, e3=`8.400000`.
4. Test edge cases: duplicates, unknown provider/model, invalid JSON/JSONL, `--from`/`--to` boundaries, unrated events with no price row, late price import.
5. Re-verify clean database: drop schema, run migration, repeat pipeline.
6. Remove `UserQuotedQuoteStrategy.php` debug code from `Kernel.php`; final code review.

## Critical Context
- Current repository is a Symfony/PHP 8.5 + Doctrine 3.7 + DBAL 4.5 + PostgreSQL 17 app.
- Source namespace `App`, mapped from `/tmp/billing-pi-zdkmfh18/repo/src`.
- Key config files:

  - `/tmp/billing-pi-zdkmfh18/repo/config/packages/doctrine_migrations.yaml`
- Current migration: `/tmp/billing-pi-zdkmfh18/repo/migrations/Version20261017082358.php`

- `/tmp/billing-pi-zdkmfh18/repo/src/Kernel.php` currently contains a **temporary debug `build()` method** with compiler passes gated by `APP_DEBUG_DUMP=1` env var — must be removed before final delivery.
- `UserQuotedQuoteStrategy` is `public=false` in DI (standard for autowired services); this is correct since it's only referenced internally by `doctrine.orm.default_configuration`.
- DoctrineBundle `Configuration.php:577` defines `quote_strategy` as a scalar node under each entity manager, defaulting to `'doctrine.orm.quote_strategy.default'`.
- DoctrineBundle `DoctrineExtension.php:953` calls `'setQuoteStrategy' => new Reference($entityManager['quote_strategy'])`.
- Relevant error messages encountered:
  - `SQLSTATE[42601]: Syntax error: 7 ERROR:  syntax error at or near "user"` (the original blocker, now fixed)

# Тестовое задание: учёт расходов на LLM-токены

Задание проверяет умение проектировать доменную логику и писать рабочий код
бэкенда. Мы ожидаем осмысленное предметное моделирование (DDD приветствуется),
аккуратную работу с деньгами и временем, и код, функциональный на базовом
уровне. Ориентир по времени — 4–6 часов; лучше меньше, но работающее, чем
больше и неработающее.

Всё выполняется в этом репозитории. Как поднять окружение — `README.md`
в корне; зависимости уже в `vendor/`.

## Контекст

Сервис перепродаёт доступ к LLM: он платит провайдерам за токены и должен
знать свои расходы в разрезе пользователей и моделей. Данные приходят двумя
потоками:

- **история цен** — справочник: провайдеры, их модели и цены, действовавшие
  с определённых моментов времени;
- **события использования** — журнал фактических запросов к моделям
  (сколько каких токенов израсходовано), поставляемый провайдерами.

Нужно консольное приложение, которое принимает эти данные и считает расходы.
Реальность вносит тонкости — все они зафиксированы в требованиях ниже:

- у провайдеров **разные схемы тарификации** (per-token с разбивкой по видам
  токенов у одного, единая цена за любой токен у другого);
- **цены меняются во времени**: событие тарифицируется ценой, действовавшей
  в его момент, а не текущей;
- у одного провайдера есть **оф-пиковая скидка** в фиксированном окне UTC;
- провайдеры **присылают дубли** событий — двойного списания быть не должно;
- деньги считаются только **точной десятичной арифметикой** (float для
  денег запрещён).

## Входные данные

### История цен — JSON-файл

Пример (сокращённый; полный рабочий пример — `fixtures/prices.json`):

```json
{
  "providers": [
    {
      "code": "prism",
      "name": "Prism AI",
      "off_peak": {
        "window_start": "16:30",
        "window_end": "00:30",
        "multiplier": "0.5"
      }
    },
    { "code": "sfera", "name": "Sfera Cloud", "off_peak": null }
  ],
  "models": [
    { "provider": "prism", "code": "lumen-8" },
    { "provider": "sfera", "code": "gyro-pro" }
  ],
  "prices": [
    {
      "provider": "prism",
      "model": "lumen-8",
      "valid_from": "2026-08-01T00:00:00Z",
      "currency": "USD",
      "unit": "per_1m_tokens",
      "rates": {
        "input": "3.000000",
        "output": "12.000000",
        "cache_read": "0.300000",
        "cache_write": "3.750000"
      }
    },
    {
      "provider": "sfera",
      "model": "gyro-pro",
      "valid_from": "2026-08-01T00:00:00Z",
      "currency": "USD",
      "unit": "per_1m_tokens_unified",
      "rates": { "any": "2.400000" }
    }
  ]
}
```

Пояснения:

- `unit` задаёт схему тарификации:
  - `per_1m_tokens` — цена за 1 000 000 токенов отдельно для каждого вида:
    `input`, `output`, `cache_read`, `cache_write`;
  - `per_1m_tokens_unified` — единая цена за 1 000 000 токенов любого вида.
- `off_peak` — окно скидки провайдера по времени суток UTC:
  `window_start` включительно, `window_end` исключительно; окно может
  переходить через полночь (`16:30`–`00:30`); `multiplier` — множитель
  стоимости события, попавшего в окно. `null` — скидки нет.
- у одной модели может быть несколько строк цен с разными `valid_from`;
- `rates` — десятичные строки (не числа JSON), 6 знаков после точки;
- `currency` везде `USD` (поле зарезервировано на будущее).

### События использования — JSONL-файл

Одно событие на строку:

```json
{"provider": "prism", "provider_request_id": "e1", "model": "lumen-8", "user": "u-alice", "ts": "2026-09-15T11:00:00Z", "tokens_input": 1200000, "tokens_output": 800000, "tokens_cache_read": 2500000, "tokens_cache_write": 83333}
```

- `ts` — момент запроса, ISO-8601, всегда UTC (`Z`);
- `user` — идентификатор пользователя (строка), домена пользователей нет;
- `provider_request_id` — идентификатор запроса **со стороны провайдера**;
  вместе с `provider` образует естественный ключ события;
- количество токенов — целые ≥ 0, любые могут быть нулевыми (в т.ч. все).

## Правила тарификации

1. **Выбор цены.** Событие тарифицируется строкой цен своей модели с
   наибольшим `valid_from` ≤ `ts` события (`valid_from` включительно).
   Если такой строки нет — событие **unrated** (см. п. 7).
2. **Схема `per_1m_tokens`** — сумма по видам токенов:
   `cost = Σ tokens_вид × rate_вид / 1 000 000`.
   **Схема `per_1m_tokens_unified`**:
   `cost = (tokens_input + tokens_output + tokens_cache_read + tokens_cache_write) × rate_any / 1 000 000`.
3. **Оф-пик.** Если время суток `ts` (UTC) попадает в окно `[window_start, window_end)`
   провайдера события — стоимость всего события умножается на `multiplier`.
   Окно задаётся на уровне провайдера и действует для всех его моделей;
   отсутствие `off_peak` означает отсутствие скидки.
4. **Точность вычислений.** Все промежуточные вычисления — без округления
   (десятичная арифметика с запасом точности, например bcmath с масштабом
   ≥ 16). Округление ровно одно: итоговая стоимость **события** округляется
   до 6 знаков после точки по правилу HALF_UP (2.5 → 3). Суммы отчёта —
   сумма уже округлённых стоимостей событий, без повторного округления
   слагаемых. Тип float для денег использовать запрещено.
5. **Идемпотентность приёма.** События дедуплицируются по ключу
   `(provider, provider_request_id)`: повторная доставка уже известного
   события целиком игнорируется (никаких обновлений, никаких доначислений).
   Одинаковые `provider_request_id` у разных провайдеров — это разные
   события.
6. **Период отчёта.** `--from` включительно, `--to` исключительно.
7. **Unrated-события.** Не считаются ошибкой: не тарифицируются, в отчёт
   не попадают. Каждый запуск тарификации повторяет попытку для всех
   ещё не рассчитанных событий (цены могли подтянуться позже).

## Команды

Все команды — через `bin/console`. Вывод отчёта — строго в stdout,
служебные сообщения — в stderr.

### `app:prices:import <file>`

Загружает провайдеров, модели и строки цен. Идемпотентный upsert:
провайдеры — по `code`; модели — по `(provider, code)`; строки цен — по
`(provider, model, valid_from)` (повторная загрузка тех же сумм — не
изменяет данных). Код выхода 0. Некорректный JSON — ошибка, код 1.

### `app:usage:import <file>`

Загружает события по правилу п. 5. Код выхода 0 даже если все строки —
дубли. Некорректная строка JSONL — ошибка, код 1.

### `app:billing:rate`

Тарифицирует все ещё не рассчитанные события (включая повторные попытки
unrated). В stdout — сводка одной строкой: `RATED=<n> UNRATED=<m>`, где
n и m — количества событий, рассчитанных и оставшихся unrated **в этом
запуске**. Для каждого unrated-события этого запуска — строка в stderr:
`UNRATED <provider>/<provider_request_id> <ts> no_price`. Код выхода 0.

### `app:billing:report [--from=<iso>] [--to=<iso>]`

CSV в stdout (кодировка UTF-8, разделитель `,`, перевод строки `\n`):

```
user,model,tokens_input,tokens_output,tokens_cache_read,tokens_cache_write,cost_usd
u-alice,prism/lumen-8,1200000,800000,2500000,83333,14.262499
u-alice,sfera/gyro-pro,3000000,500000,0,0,8.400000
u-bob,prism/lumen-8,2000000,1000000,0,0,11.000000
TOTAL,,6200000,2300000,2500000,83333,33.662499
```

Требования к формату:

- первая строка — заголовок, точно как в примере;
- строки данных — по одной на пару (user, model), отсортированные по
  `user`, затем по `model` (лексикографически, по возрастанию);
- `model` — `<provider>/<code>` (например `prism/lumen-8`);
- количества токенов — суммы по событиям группы, целые без разделителей;
- `cost_usd` — сумма стоимостей событий группы, ровно 6 знаков после
  точки;
- последняя строка — `TOTAL` с пустым полем `model` и суммами по отчёту;
- unrated-события в отчёт не попадают никогда.

`--from`/`--to` — ISO-8601 (UTC), применяются к `ts` событий по п. 6;
без опций отчёт покрывает все события.

## Пример расчёта

Файлы этого примера лежат в `fixtures/` (`prices.json`, `usage.jsonl`) —
воспроизведите его сами. Три события:

| id | событие | разбор |
|----|---------|--------|
| e1 | prism/lumen-8, alice, `2026-09-15T11:00:00Z`, in 1 200 000, out 800 000, cr 2 500 000, cw 83 333 | цена — строка с 2026-08-01 (смена цены в 12:00 ещё не наступила); 11:00 — пик. Точная стоимость: `1.2M×3 + 0.8M×12 + 2.5M×0.3 + 83333×3.75/1M = 3.6 + 9.6 + 0.75 + 0.31249875 = 14.26249875` → округление события → **14.262499** |
| e2 | prism/lumen-8, bob, `2026-09-15T12:00:00Z`, in 2 000 000, out 1 000 000 | `12:00:00` — момент смены цены, действует новая строка (`valid_from` включительно): `2M×1.5 + 1M×8 = 11.000000` |
| e3 | sfera/gyro-pro, alice, `2026-09-20T17:10:00Z`, in 3 000 000, out 500 000 | unified: `3.5M×2.4 = 8.400000`; у sfera нет оф-пик — время суток не важно |

Отчёт за сентябрь (`--from 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z --to 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z`)
должен выдать в точности:

```

u-alice,prism/lumen-8,1200000,800000,2500000,83333,14.262499
u-alice,sfera/gyro-pro,3000000,500000,0,0,8.400000
u-bob,prism/lumen-8,2000000,1000000,0,0,11.000000
TOTAL,,6200000,2300000,2500000,83333,33.662499
```

## Бонус (по желанию, оценивается отдельно)

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Command;

use App\Application\Prices\PriceFileParser;
use App\Application\Prices\PricesImportService;
use App\Exception\InvalidPricesFileException;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Attribute\AsCommand;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Command\Command;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Input\InputArgument;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Input\InputInterface;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Output\OutputInterface;

#[AsCommand(
    name: 'app:billing:import-prices',
    description: 'Import provider/model/price history from a JSON file (idempotent).',
)]
final class ImportPricesCommand extends Command
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly PriceFileParser $parser,
        private readonly PricesImportService $importer,
    ) {
        parent::__construct();
    }

    protected function configure(): void
    {
        $this
            ->addArgument('file', InputArgument::REQUIRED, 'Path to the price history JSON file')
            ->setHelp(
                'Parses the JSON file (top-level object with sections providers/models/prices), '
                .'validates the schema and upserts the data into the database. '
                .'The command is idempotent: the same file may be re-imported safely. '
                .'Exit code: 0 on success, 1 on parse/validation errors or a failed transaction.'
            );
    }

    protected function execute(InputInterface $input, OutputInterface $output): int
    {
        $path = (string) $input->getArgument('file');

        if (!is_file($path)) {
            $output->writeln(sprintf('<error>file not found: %s</error>', $path));

            return Command::FAILURE;
        }

        $json = @file_get_contents($path);
        if ($json === false) {
            $output->writeln(sprintf('<error>cannot read file: %s</error>', $path));

            return Command::FAILURE;
        }

        try {
            $spec = $this->parser->parse($json);
        } catch (InvalidPricesFileException $e) {
            $output->writeln(sprintf('<error>invalid prices file: %s</error>', $e->getMessage()));

            return Command::FAILURE;
        }

        try {
            $counts = $this->importer->import($spec);
        } catch (InvalidPricesFileException $e) {
            $output->writeln(sprintf('<error>import failed: %s</error>', $e->getMessage()));

            return Command::FAILURE;
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            $output->writeln(sprintf('<error>import failed: %s</error>', $e->getMessage()));

            return Command::FAILURE;
        }

        $output->writeln(sprintf(
            'prices imported: providers=%d models=%d price_rows=%d',
            $counts['providers'],
            $counts['models'],
            $counts['price_rows'],
        ));

        return Command::SUCCESS;
    }
}

#[AsCommand(
    name: 'app:billing:report',
    description: 'CSV report per (user, model) for a time range; printed to stdout.',
)]
final class ReportCommand extends Command
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly ReportService $reports,
    ) {
        parent::__construct();
    }

    protected function configure(): void
    {
        $this
            ->addOption('from', null, InputOption::VALUE_REQUIRED, 'Range start, inclusive, ISO-8601 UTC (Z), compared with event ts')
            ->addOption('to', null, InputOption::VALUE_REQUIRED, 'Range end, exclusive, ISO-8601 UTC (Z), compared with event ts')
            ->setHelp(
                'Aggregates rated events (unrated are never included) by (user, model) and prints '
                .'the CSV per TASK.md section 7 to stdout: one row per pair '
                .'(totals of token counters and cost_usd, 6 decimal places) plus a TOTAL row. '
                .'`--from` is inclusive, `--to` exclusive; when both are given, from <= to. '
                .'Exit code: 0 on success, 1 on invalid options or errors.'
            );
    }

    protected function execute(InputInterface $input, OutputInterface $output): int
    {
        $from = $this->parseRangeOption((string) $input->getOption('from'), '--from', $output);
        if ($from === false) {
            return Command::FAILURE;
        }
        $to = $this->parseRangeOption((string) $input->getOption('to'), '--to', $output);
        if ($to === false) {
            return Command::FAILURE;
        }

        if ($from !== null && $to !== null && $from > $to) {
            $output->writeln('<error>--from must be <= --to</error>');

            return Command::FAILURE;
        }

        try {
            $csv = $this->reports->buildCsv($from, $to);
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            $output->writeln(sprintf('<error>report failed: %s</error>', $e->getMessage()));

            return Command::FAILURE;
        }

        $output->write($csv);

        return Command::SUCCESS;
    }

    private function parseRangeOption(
        string $value,
        string $option,
        OutputInterface $output,
    ): DateTimeImmutable|false {
        if ($value === '') {
            return null;
        }

        try {
            return JsonInput::isoUtcDateTime(['value' => $value], 'value', sprintf('%s', $option), BillingException::class);
        } catch (BillingException $e) {
            $output->writeln(sprintf('<error>%s: %s</error>', $option, $e->getMessage()));

            return false;
        }
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Application\Billing;

use App\Domain\Billing\RateCalculator;
use App\Domain\Shared\TimeOfDay;
use App\Domain\Usage\UsageEvent;
use App\Domain\Usage\UsageStatus;
use DateTimeImmutable;
use Doctrine\ORM\EntityManagerInterface;

/**
 * Тарификация событий (p. 1-4, 7 задания):
 *
 *  - выбирают строку цен модели с наибольшим `valid_from <= ts` события
 *    (`valid_from` включительно); нет строки — событие unrated;
 *  - стоимость считается точно (bcmath, масштаб 32) и ровно один раз
 *    округляется до 6 знаков HALF_UP;
 *  - оф-пик провайдера применяется по UTC-времени суток `ts`;
 *  - каждый запуск повторяет попытку для всех ещё unrated-событий
 *    (цены могли подтянуться позже).
 */
final class RatingService
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly EntityManagerInterface $em,
        private readonly RateCalculator $calculator,
    ) {
    }

    public function rateAll(): RatingResult
    {
        $em = $this->em;

        return $em->getConnection()->transactional(function () use ($em): RatingResult {
            $pending = $em->createQuery(
                'SELECT e FROM App\\Domain\\Usage\\UsageEvent e WHERE e.status = :status ORDER BY e.id ASC'
            )
                ->setParameter('status', UsageStatus::Pending)
                ->getResult();

            $rated = 0;
            /** @var UnratedEvent[] $unrated */
            $unrated = [];
            $now = new DateTimeImmutable();

            foreach ($pending as $event) {
                $row = $this->applicablePriceRow($em, $event);
                if ($row === null) {
                    $unrated[] = new UnratedEvent(
                        $event->getProvider()->getCode(),
                        $event->getProviderRequestId(),
                        $event->getTs(),
                    );
                    continue;
                }

                $cost = $this->calculator->eventCost(
                    $event->getTokenCounts(),
                    $row,
                    $event->getProvider()->offPeakPolicy(),
                    TimeOfDay::minutesOfDayUtc($event->getTs()),
                );
                $event->markRated($cost, $row, $now);
                $rated++;
            }

            $em->flush();

            return new RatingResult($rated, $unrated);
        });
    }

    /**
     * Строка цен с наибольшим `valid_from <= ts` (п. 1) — или null,
     * если для модели события ещё нет ни одной применимой строки.
     */
    private function applicablePriceRow(EntityManagerInterface $em, UsageEvent $event): ?\App\Domain\Pricing\PriceRow
    {
        return $em->createQuery(
            'SELECT r FROM App\Domain\Pricing\PriceRow r
             WHERE r.model = :model
               AND r.validFrom <= :ts
             ORDER BY r.validFrom DESC'
        )
            ->setParameter('model', $event->getModel())
            ->setParameter('ts', $event->getTs(), \Doctrine\DBAL\Types\Types::DATETIME_IMMUTABLE)
            ->setMaxResults(1)
            ->getOneOrNullResult();
    }
}

 *    (лексикографически, возрастанию);
 *  - cost_usd — сумма уже округлённых стоимостей событий группы,
 *    ровно 6 знаков; суммы событий — без повторного округления;
 *  - CSV: UTF-8, разделитель «,», перевод строки «\n».
 */
final class ReportService
{
    private const HEADER = 'user,model,tokens_input,tokens_output,tokens_cache_read,tokens_cache_write,cost_usd';

    public function __construct(
        private readonly EntityManagerInterface $em,
    ) {
    }

    public function buildCsv(null|DateTimeImmutable $from, null|DateTimeImmutable $to): string
    {
        $em = $this->em;

        $where = ['e.status = :status'];
        $params = ['status' => UsageStatus::Rated];
        if ($from !== null) {
            $where[] = 'e.ts >= :from';
            $params['from'] = [$from, Types::DATETIME_IMMUTABLE];
        }
        if ($to !== null) {
            $where[] = 'e.ts < :to';
            $params['to'] = [$to, Types::DATETIME_IMMUTABLE];
        }

        $events = $em->createQuery(
            'SELECT e FROM App\\Domain\\Usage\\UsageEvent e
             WHERE '.implode(' AND ', $where).'
             ORDER BY e.id ASC'
        );
        foreach ($params as $name => $value) {
            if (is_array($value)) {
                $events->setParameter($name, $value[0], $value[1]);
            } else {
                $events->setParameter($name, $value);
            }
        }
        $events = $events->getResult();

        /** @var array<string, array{user:string, model:string, input:int, output:int, cache_read:int, cache_write:int, cost:string}> $groups */
        $groups = [];

        foreach ($events as $event) {
            /** @var UsageEvent $event */
            $user = $event->getUser();
            $model = $event->getProvider()->getCode().'/'.$event->getModel()->getCode();
            $key = $user."\x1f".$model;

            if (!isset($groups[$key])) {
                $groups[$key] = [
                    'user' => $user,
                    'model' => $model,
                    'input' => 0,
                    'output' => 0,
                    'cache_read' => 0,
                    'cache_write' => 0,
                    'cost' => '0',
                ];
            }

            $groups[$key]['input'] += $event->getTokensInput();
            $groups[$key]['output'] += $event->getTokensOutput();
            $groups[$key]['cache_read'] += $event->getTokensCacheRead();
            $groups[$key]['cache_write'] += $event->getTokensCacheWrite();
            $groups[$key]['cost'] = Decimal::add($groups[$key]['cost'], $event->getCost() ?? '0');
        }

        $lines = [self::HEADER];
        $totals = ['input' => 0, 'output' => 0, 'cache_read' => 0, 'cache_write' => 0, 'cost' => '0'];

        uasort($groups, static function (array $a, array $b): int {
            $byUser = strcmp($a['user'], $b['user']);
            if ($byUser !== 0) {
                return $byUser;
            }

            return strcmp($a['model'], $b['model']);
        });

        foreach ($groups as $group) {
            $lines[] = sprintf(
                '%s,%s,%d,%d,%d,%d,%s',
                $group['user'],
                $group['model'],
                $group['input'],
                $group['output'],
                $group['cache_read'],
                $group['cache_write'],
                Decimal::format6($group['cost']),
            );
            $totals['input'] += $group['input'];
            $totals['output'] += $group['output'];
            $totals['cache_read'] += $group['cache_read'];
            $totals['cache_write'] += $group['cache_write'];
            $totals['cost'] = Decimal::add($totals['cost'], $group['cost']);
        }

        $lines[] = sprintf(
            'TOTAL,,%d,%d,%d,%d,%s',
            $totals['input'],
            $totals['output'],
            $totals['cache_read'],
            $totals['cache_write'],
            Decimal::format6($totals['cost']),
        );

        return implode("\n", $lines)."\n";
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Application\Billing;

use App\Application\Prices\PriceFileSpec;
use App\Domain\Billing\PriceCorrection;
use App\Domain\Billing\RateCalculator;
use App\Domain\Pricing\Model;
use App\Domain\Pricing\PriceRow;
use App\Domain\Pricing\Provider;
use App\Domain\Shared\Decimal;
use App\Domain\Shared\TimeOfDay;
use App\Domain\Usage\UsageStatus;
use App\Exception\InvalidRepriceFileException;
use Doctrine\ORM\EntityManagerInterface;

/**
 * Ретро-коррекция цены (бонус задание `app:billing:reprice`).
 *
 * Механизм:
 *  1. Провайдеры из секции файла применяются upsert'ом по code
 *     (название / окно оф-пик).
 *  2. Секции `models` используются как проверка: каждая пара
 *     (provider, code) должна существовать в базе (не только в файле).
 *  3. Строки цен upsert'ятся по (provider, model, valid_from) по уже
 *     загруженному справочнику; провайдер и модель обязаны существовать
 *     в базе.
 *  4. Все уже rated-события, тарифицировавшиеся затронутыми строками,
 *     пересчитываются новой строкой (вместе с текущей политикой оф-пик
 *     провайдера); для каждого события в журнал `price_corrections`
 *     пишется пара «старая/новая стоимость».
 *  5. Стоимость в `usage_events` пересчитывается на месте — отчёт
 *     показывает новые суммы без задвоений, unrated-события не трогаются.
 *
 * @return array{events:int, delta_usd:string}
 *
 * @throws InvalidRepriceFileException
 */
final class RepriceService
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly EntityManagerInterface $em,
        private readonly RateCalculator $calculator,
    ) {
    }

    public function reprice(PriceFileSpec $spec): array
    {
        $em = $this->em;

        return $em->getConnection()->transactional(function () use ($em, $spec): array {
            $providerCache = self::upsertProviders($em, $spec);
            self::validateModels($em, $spec, $providerCache);

            $affectedRows = self::upsertPriceRows($em, $spec, $providerCache);
            $em->flush();

            /** @var \App\Domain\Usage\UsageEvent[] $events */
            $events = $em->createQuery(
                'SELECT e FROM App\Domain\Usage\UsageEvent e
                 WHERE e.status = :status
                   AND e.priceRow IN (SELECT r.id FROM App\Domain\Pricing\PriceRow r WHERE r.id IN (:rows))'
            )
                ->setParameter('status', UsageStatus::Rated)
                ->setParameter('rows', array_keys($affectedRows))
                ->getResult();

            $count = 0;
            $oldSum = '0';
            $newSum = '0';

            foreach ($events as $event) {
                $row = $affectedRows[$event->getPriceRow()->getId()];
                $oldCost = $event->getCost() ?? '0';
                $newCost = $this->calculator->eventCost(
                    $event->getTokenCounts(),
                    $row,
                    $event->getProvider()->offPeakPolicy(),
                    TimeOfDay::minutesOfDayUtc($event->getTs()),
                );

                $event->changeRatedCost($newCost);
                $em->persist(new PriceCorrection($event, $row, $oldCost, $newCost));

                $count++;
                $oldSum = Decimal::add($oldSum, $oldCost);
                $newSum = Decimal::add($newSum, $newCost);
            }

            $em->flush();

            return [
                'events' => $count,
                'delta_usd' => Decimal::sub($newSum, $oldSum),
            ];
        });
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, Provider> $providerCache
     *
     * @return array<int, Provider>
     */
    private static function upsertProviders(EntityManagerInterface $em, PriceFileSpec $spec): array
    {
        $cache = [];
        foreach ($spec->providers as $p) {
            $provider = $em->getRepository(Provider::class)->findOneBy(['code' => $p->code]);
            if ($provider === null) {
                $provider = new Provider(
                    $p->code,
                    $p->name,
                    $p->offPeak?->startMinutes,
                    $p->offPeak?->endMinutes,
                    $p->offPeak?->multiplier,
                );
                $em->persist($provider);
            } else {
                $provider->update(
                    $p->name,
                    $p->offPeak?->startMinutes,
                    $p->offPeak?->endMinutes,
                    $p->offPeak?->multiplier,
                );
            }
            $cache[$p->code] = $provider;
        }

        return $cache;
    }

    /**
     * Модели из файла должны существовать в базе (провайдер — тоже).
     *
     * @param array<string, Provider> $providerCache
     */
    private static function validateModels(EntityManagerInterface $em, PriceFileSpec $spec, array $providerCache): void
    {
        foreach ($spec->models as $m) {
            self::resolveModel($em, $m->provider, $m->code, $providerCache);
        }
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, Provider> $providerCache
     *
     * @return array<int, PriceRow> id строки => сущность
     */
    private static function upsertPriceRows(EntityManagerInterface $em, PriceFileSpec $spec, array $providerCache): array
    {
        $affected = [];
        foreach ($spec->priceRows as $r) {
            $provider = self::resolveProvider($em, $r->provider, $providerCache);
            $model = self::resolveModel($em, $r->provider, $r->model, $providerCache);

            $row = $em->getRepository(PriceRow::class)->findOneBy([
                'provider' => $provider,
                'model' => $model,
                'validFrom' => $r->validFrom,
            ]);

            if ($row === null) {
                $row = new PriceRow(
                    $provider,
                    $model,
                    $r->validFrom,
                    $r->currency,
                    $r->unit,
                    $r->rates['input'] ?? null,
                    $r->rates['output'] ?? null,
                    $r->rates['cache_read'] ?? null,
                    $r->rates['cache_write'] ?? null,
                    $r->rates['any'] ?? null,
                );
                $em->persist($row);
            } else {
                $row->replaceRates($r->currency, $r->unit, $r->rates);
            }

            $em->flush(); // id уже назначен — для коллекции затронутых строк
            $affected[$row->getId() ?? 0] = $row;
        }

        return $affected;
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, Provider> $cache
     */
    private static function resolveProvider(EntityManagerInterface $em, string $code, array $cache): Provider
    {
        if (isset($cache[$code])) {
            return $cache[$code];
        }

        $provider = $em->getRepository(Provider::class)->findOneBy(['code' => $code]);
        if ($provider === null) {
            throw new InvalidRepriceFileException(sprintf('provider "%s" not found in the loaded reference data', $code));
        }

        $cache[$code] = $provider;

        return $provider;
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, Provider> $cache
     */
    private static function resolveModel(EntityManagerInterface $em, string $providerCode, string $modelCode, array $cache): Model
    {
        $provider = self::resolveProvider($em, $providerCode, $cache);
        $model = $em->getRepository(Model::class)->findOneBy(['provider' => $provider, 'code' => $modelCode]);
        if ($model === null) {
            throw new InvalidRepriceFileException(sprintf('model "%s/%s" not found in the loaded reference data', $providerCode, $modelCode));
        }

        return $model;
    }
}
